Highest Grossing Kollywood Films Overseas: Superstar Rajinikanth starrer Jailer 2 tops, First to USD 25 million

The film is simply phenomenal in the Middle East, where it will be over USD 8.50 million EOD today. That is almost USD 2 million higher than the previous best Kollywood film in the region.

By Jatinder Singh
Published on Oct 25, 2026  |  07:37 PM IST |  97K
Prahaar Opening Week Box Office Collections: Rajkummar Rao starrer collects Rs 16 crore in 7 days, marching towards disappointing end
follow us
share
Rajinikanth in Jailer 2 (image courtesy of Sun Pictures)
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 10:40
Instaread

Jailer 2 is on a fantastic run overseas, emerging not only as the top-grossing Kollywood film of all time internationally but also as the first one to surpass the USD 25 million mark. By the end of business today, the Rajinikanth starrer will have grossed around USD 26 million internationally. Reaching the USD 30 million mark will be a tough ask from here, but it is certainly not out of reach.

Advertisement

The film is simply phenomenal in the Middle East, where it will be over USD 8.50 million EOD today. That is almost USD 2 million higher than the previous best Kollywood film in the region. It is said that the presence of Mohanlal is a big contributing factor to this, which is true, but interestingly, the film could possibly cross the biggest Malayalam film in the region eventually. Even if it falls a bit short, it should certainly do that in the UAE. 

The film is super strong in almost all other markets. It is either the record grosser already in many of them or will become one eventually. The traditional Tamil markets of Malaysia, Singapore and Sri Lanka could prove more challenging, where it seems like it will be a close call, but strong late legs could get it over.

The Top Ten Kollywood films Overseas are as follows:

Rank Title Year Gross
1 Jailer 2 2026 USD 26.00 M
2 Leo 2023 USD 23.60 M
3 Jailer 2023 USD 23.50 M
4 2.0 2018 USD 21.75 M
5 Ponniyin Selvan: I 2022 USD 20.40 M
6 Coolie 2025 USD 20.25 M
7 The Greatest of All Time 2024 USD 19.15 M
8 Endhiran 2010 USD 16.35 M
9 Ponniyin Selvan: II 2023 USD 15.70 M
10 Vikram 2022 USD 15.40 M

Doraemon Castle of the Undersea Devil Box Office Collections: Anime film fetches Rs 2.50 crore in Week 3, grosses Rs 27 crore in 21 days

By Mohit Dixit

Doraemon Castle of the Undersea Devil Box Office Collections: Anime film fetches Rs 2.50 crore in Week 3, grosses Rs 27 crore in 21 days

Doraemon Castle of the Undersea Devil collected Rs. 2.50 crore in its third week. The movie registered a 75 per cent drop from the previous week. It took its 21-day theatrical cume to the Rs. 26.75 crore gross mark at the Indian box office. 

The Anime film is now running in its final phase. It is expected to end its entire run in India soon, possibly around Rs. 29 to 30 crore gross. That will be an encouraging total for the film.

For the record, it emerged as the highest-grossing installment of the Doraemon franchise. The previous best from the franchise was Rs. 5 crore gross. That said, the latest installment is all set to end up doing nearly 6x the previous best. 

Week-wise box office collections of Doraemon Castle of the Undersea Devil in India are as follows: 

Week Box Office
Week 1  Rs. 14.75 crore 
Week 2 Rs. 9.50 crore
Week 3  Rs. 2.50 crore
   
Total Rs. 26.75 crore gross

About Doraemon: Castle of the Undersea Devil

Doraemon Castle of the Undersea Devil follows Nobita and his friends as they embark on an undersea camping adventure using Doraemon’s futuristic gadgets. Their journey leads them to the hidden Mu Federation and a terrifying discovery: the ancient Atlantis civilization’s rogue AI, Poseidon, has activated a weapon capable of destroying Earth.

The group teams up with Mu’s El and ventures into the Bermuda Triangle to stop Poseidon. Whether they manage to succeed in their mission is explored in the film.

Prahaar Opening Week Box Office Collections: Rajkummar Rao starrer collects Rs 16 crore in 7 days, marching towards disappointing end

Prahaar Opening Week Box Office Collections: Rajkummar Rao starrer collects Rs 16 crore in 7 days, marching towards disappointing end

Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam added Rs 1 to 1.10 crore to the tally on its Day 7 (Thursday), registering a 20 per cent drop from the previous day. The movie wrapped up its first week at Rs. 16 crore nett at the Indian box office. 

Directed by Avinash Arun, the movie garnered mixed reception among the audience, which is why it is struggling at the box office. Had the film met with positive reviews, it would have performed slightly better. The movie needs to show strong hold in the second week to have a chance at the box office. 

Considering how the film is performing at the box office, it is heading to close its entire run around Rs. 25 to 35 crore nett in India. That said, the movie is marching towards a disappointing end.

About Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam

Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam follows an attorney navigating a challenging and high-profile case while dealing with professional pressure and strained family relationships. Relying on evidence, strategy, and principles, he fights for justice while facing the complexities of the system and the personal sacrifices that come with a landmark battle.

Apart from Rajkummar Rao, the film features Lalit Prabhakar, Jaideep Ahlawat, Wamiqa Gabbi, Ashish Vidyarthi, Sikandar Kher, Nassar, Tarun Sharma, Ritvik Sahore, Prasanna Ketkar, Ajinkya Deo, and Pranali Ghogare in key roles.

Nayyi Navelli Box Office: Yami Gautam starrer horror comedy collects Rs 20 crore in first week, needs strong trends ahead

Nayyi Navelli collected Rs. 1.25 crore on its Day 7 (Thursday), registering a 28 per cent drop from the previous day. The movie took its first-week theatrical cume to Rs. 20.50 crore nett at the Indian box office. That's a low first week. 

The only consolation for Nayyi Navelli is that it is performing better than Prahaar at the box office, but trailing behind Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 in Hindi. The Yami Gautam starrer is expected to see some growth in the second weekend and take its running cume to Rs. 25 crore or so. 

Based on current trends, the movie is heading to close its entire run around Rs.30 to 40 crore mark. It is heading to towards a disappointing end at the box office.

About Nayyi Navelli

Set in Meerut, Nayyi Navelli follows a troubled household whose fortunes change after a mysterious new bride arrives. Her seemingly miraculous abilities bring peace and prosperity to the family, but her presence soon raises suspicions. While some believe she has supernatural powers, others suspect she could be a witch.

The film stars Yami Gautam Dhar alongside Adinath Kothare, Mita Vashisht, Sonal Jha, Sunita Rajwar, Rajesh Dubey, Aaditya Kulshreshth and Prateek Pachauri.
